lines.text: Coming down the mountain, Jesus meets a crowd, and a man says a spirit keeps seizing his only son.
The disciples could not drive out the spirit, so Jesus healed the boy and gave him back to the priest.
Jesus tells His disciples the Son of Man will be delivered into men's hands, but they do not understand.
As the disciples argue over greatness, Jesus has a tax collector stand beside Him and says the least is greatest.
John says they tried stopping a man driving out demons in Jesus' name, but Jesus says not to.
